scope: Connected Resolve command review/automation family: independent Silent/Noquestion, checked and direct staging, source Skip-only mode, cleanup, captured authorization/adoption/preferences, exact review/direct ownership and cancellation.
implementation: Resolve accepts independent silent/noquestion flags, preserved through path-file resolution/selection. Other commands reject them and valued flags remain invalid.

Normal command review retains its checked targets and uses existing real progress. Silent review applies only to outer checklist acceptance; context resolutions retain their independent confirmation/progress. Silent success closes; failure retains an acknowledgment error without a progress panel.

Combined Silent/Noquestion force-adds original literal inputs, including ignored/unversioned files and directories/root, one selected path at a time. All paths must validate inside the same working tree before mutation; each item rechecks ownership. First failure/cancellation stops later items without rolling back prior effects. NUL path packets retain literal/exact spelling.

Noquestion without Silent preserves the pinned source behavior: skipping status population leaves raw argv paths without UNMERGED action flags, so progress reports Skip and does not stage them. Success retains existing Close/Commit post-action policy. This source-specific behavior is documented explicitly.

Successful direct and ordinary checked resolutions unlink source LOCAL/REMOTE/BASE sibling files using source filename-extension spelling. Unlink does not follow symlinks or recursively remove directories; other backups remain. Folder/root selections do not clean neighboring artifacts outside that folder.

Resolve shares captured command permission/metadata discovery and root adoption with Edit Conflict. Mixed-root inputs are rejected before adoption rather than silently dropped by relative-path conversion. Original window/settings and related grants survive handoff.

Resolve window maps use exact Git path keys and identity-checked close callbacks. Reviews reuse checks/models per mode. Pending direct Silent batches coalesce by exact root/paths; owner closure/retirement cancels, retains pending/Quit lifetime through real drain, refreshes possible partial effects and refuses late result/error delivery.
